Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1865 that have a canonical SMILES and are from a PubMed-indexed document. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Use the provenance path molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. INNER JOIN compound_structures to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter by assay CHEMBL1865, standard_type IC50, and docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
